deployment: Publish the complete widget; no Deluge function changes required
dependencies: Previously implemented pending-operations.js and pending-operations.css must be included
behavior: Read-only consistency checks use the booking already open in Trip closure. The standalone tab is removed; browser-local pending operations remain in the global header.

Checks remain read-only. The explicit Sync status copies action re-reads and updates only reported allocation status-copy fields in the current booking, suppresses workflows and verifies the writes. No amount changes or accounting entry generation.
Loads all allocations for shared payments, including invoices from other bookings, before comparing payment totals and counters.

Checks invoice paid amounts and overallocations, payment amounts/movement/counters, duplicate or orphan relationships, copied financial statuses, settlement aggregates and source payment links/statuses.
Uses existing two-decimal rules, credit note signs, Paid/Reconciled payment criteria and active invoice/settlement allocation rules. Empty aggregate fields follow the existing zero default.
Pending invoice operations, invalid values and currency conflicts prevent unreliable aggregate comparisons and produce review findings.
Strict paginated reads fail the review on errors, repeated/missing IDs or a 5000-record per-query limit. Scope changes and failed scans clear previous results.
Results show recorded versus calculated values, category filters and CRM record opening through the existing SDK. Manual administrative states are not derived or modified.
Closing, refreshing or switching the trip invalidates results and ignores late responses. Findings do not change existing closure rules or manual review statuses.

Compact bar after financial indicators, internal results view with preserved settlement DOM, tabular findings and explicit allocation status-copy labels. Checked records explains inclusion of No services settlements and shared payments.
Individual allocation and settlement-split findings are scoped to the current booking. External records remain inputs for full shared-payment totals, counters and completeness checks.
Status-copy synchronization prevents duplicate clicks, rejects pending or cross-booking records, reports per-allocation failures and reruns the full check. Retries are idempotent.

limits: A review is scoped to one booking and its linked payments; it is not an organisation-wide audit and cannot discover wholly unlinked payments with no booking context.
Pending operations remain browser-local, not shared across users.
CRM reads are not an atomic snapshot. Results are dated and users must rerun after changes.
Does not audit tax/base calculations, documents, service statuses, manual states, or background workflows. Does not infer currency conversions.
No historical repair or test financial mutation was performed.
